entities.name: UL user data packet
entities.description: Uplink user data packet received from upper layers for transmission via a PDU session.

entities.name: QFI
entities.description: QoS Flow Identifier used to mark user data packets for QoS handling.

entities.name: Signalled QoS rule
entities.description: QoS rule with packet filters for UL or both directions, evaluated in precedence order.

entities.name: Derived QoS rule
entities.description: QoS rule with packet filter for UL direction only.

entities.name: Default QoS rule
entities.description: QoS rule used for unstructured PDU session type.

entities.name: Packet filter
entities.description: Filter used to match UL user data packets against QoS rules.

entities.name: Precedence value
entities.description: Value determining evaluation order of QoS rules.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: Session context for user data transmission.

relations.description: UL user data packet is matched against signalled QoS rule packet filters.
UL user data packet is matched against derived QoS rule packet filters.
UL user data packet is associated with default QoS rule for unstructured PDU session type.
Signalled QoS rule contains packet filters for UL or both directions.
Derived QoS rule contains packet filter for UL direction.
Signalled QoS rules are evaluated in increasing order of precedence values.
Derived QoS rules are evaluated in increasing order of precedence values.
If UL user data packet matches a QoS rule, it is associated with a QFI.
UL user data packet is transmitted via a PDU session.
